_readme: Every reward, price and shop rule lives here. Edit numbers, save, reload the game. The game reads 'rewards', 'events' and 'shop'. All shop items below are PLACEHOLDER test data - names, prices and effects are just there so the shop has something to show (effects are not applied yet). See docs/ECONOMY.md for what every field means, and run 'py tools/economy_report.py' for a quick balance table.

rewards._note: The base coins for hitting each window come from the projectile in use - see 'projectiles' below (rewards.W20 / rewards.W21). The streak is only a counter now: it adds no coins.

_aimNote: Speed of the two aim markers (offset and strength - always the same, fixed speed). markerHz = full back-and-forth sweeps per second (0.85 = one sweep in ~1.2s). Nothing changes it: not the streak, not buffs, not the projectile. offsetZoneAtWeight100 = the share of the OFFSET slider that is a guaranteed W20 hit for a weight-100 projectile (the snowball): 0.5 = half the slider. A weight of 0 always needs the exact middle (share 0), a weight of 200 hits anywhere (share 1), and every other weight is on a straight line through these three points. Lower it to make the snowball offset harder - note that with 0.5 the snowball offset slider only spans +-0.31 swing, which is too short to reach W21 (it needs about +-0.37).
_rarityNote: Every projectile (in "projectiles") and every buff (in the shop items) has a rarity number, bigger = rarer: the PROJECTILES and BUFFS tabs list the rarest first (equal rarities: projectiles by W20 hit value, buffs in file order). The numbers are PLACEHOLDERS - 1, 2, 3 in the current order - to be decided later.
_weightLabelsNote: The words shown on a projectile's card instead of its exact weight: the last entry whose 'from' is at most the weight. Now: 0+ very light, 50+ light, 75+ moderate, 125+ heavy, 150+ very heavy.
_raritiesNote: Rarities, from the lowest to the rarest. default (light grey, chance 0) is the snowball's: it can never come up in the shop. For the others a shop slot first rolls a rarity by chance (percent - only rarities that have an item to sell take part, and their chances are rescaled to 100), then picks one of that rarity's items at random. color is CSS text colour, or rainbow (animated waves + a pulsing shine). Every projectile (in projectiles) and every shop item names one with rarity; the PROJECTILES and BUFFS tabs list the rarest first and an item with NO rarity always goes at the very end, after default and common.
_projectilesNote: Gameplay numbers for every projectile you can equip (the id must match its shop item / its entry in the PROJECTILES list). regen { max, everySeconds }: a refilling stock (the snowball): the player starts with max, every one thrown is given back at one per everySeconds (by the device clock, also while the app is closed), and its card never leaves the list even at 0. infinite: true = never runs out (none right now). Every other projectile is a CONSUMABLE: one is used up the moment the player taps TAP to aim, and it is NOT given back if the aim is abandoned; when the last one is gone the snowball is equipped again. rewards: the BASE coins for a hit on W20 / W21 with this projectile. weight: NOT shown to the player (only as a word, see weightLabels). The snowball is always 100 - the reference. It sets two things: (1) STRENGTH: the perfect W20 throw (the middle of the window) is at strength slider position weight / 200 - 100 = the centre of the slider, 200 = the very tip, 0 = the very beginning; (2) OFFSET: the share of the offset slider that hits W20 - 0 = only the exact middle, 200 = anywhere on the slider (see aim.offsetZoneAtWeight100 for the snowball, straight lines in between). leavesMark: false = no snow mark, it bounces off instead. spins: it rotates in flight.

shop._priceOverrideNote: PLACEHOLDER: while priceOverride is a number, EVERY item costs that many coins in the shop (so we can test buying). Set it to null to use each item's real 'price' below.
shop._restockNote: After buying, that slot shows SOLD OUT for this many seconds (by the device clock, so it also counts while the app is closed), then restocks. 1800 = 30 minutes (60 = 1 minute is handy for testing; 3600 = 1 hour).
shop._buffMaxNote: The most copies of ONE buff the player can hold. Buying one they are already maxed on is refused like too little money (the card shakes, nothing is charged).
shop._itemsNote: Empty slots show (TBD) - the shop only has real items now. Optional item field image = a picture path for the card. Consumables are timed BUFFS: bought = active right away for duration.seconds, with a list of effects (guideLines, precision, strengthControl, coinMultiplier - see src/buffs.js). a single item can have priceRange {min, max} instead of price: its price is rolled in that range each time it is put on sale. category is 'consumable' (a timed buff: can be on sale in several slots at once; needs a duration) or 'projectile' (a stack of consumable projectiles: each time it is put on sale the amount (amount.min..max) and the price of ONE (unitPrice.min..max) are rolled at random, the slot's price is amount x unitPrice; the same stack can be on sale in several slots at once, each with its own roll).
